name: FidelicAI: Hire AI Agents
description:
FidelicAI is an AI workforce platform for small businesses. Use Claude to match business work to a published AI agent; compare doing the work with a custom system, a hired role, or a human lead; inspect the role's public rates and limits; and open the accurate hire path. A Day Pass is one active day with the selected role and can carry one substantial assignment or several in-scope requests. It is not a per-task meter.

FidelicAI uses Claude Managed Agents as the hosted runtime for production role systems that need persistent tool use and long-running work. FidelicAI participates in the Claude Partner Network. Anthropic does not endorse this public connector, a returned role, or a customer hiring decision.

Claude helps the buyer choose and prepare the hire. The hired fidelic agent does the role work. Each fidelic agent is a production role formed over months around attributable sources, written work methods, production tools, evaluation gates, a tested deployment, and continued maintenance. This does not claim special model weights; Claude and a fidelic agent may use the same foundation model without being equivalent work systems.

Claude can also search and read FidelicAI Field Guide articles, Research, Hard Questions, decision guides, use cases, and comparisons, or return official setup, private support, and Slack community routes.

A hired fidelic agent works through Slack, WhatsApp, or Microsoft Teams according to the chosen setup. Checkout, payment, and customer-workspace connection finish securely at start.fidelic.ai; the connector does not charge a card, install Slack, or deploy an agent. No connector account is required. Requests are processed only to return the selected public information or first-party link and are not stored by the application. Do not include confidential business information in a roster or publication search.

_published_faq.name: How do I add FidelicAI: Hire AI Agents to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add FidelicAI: Hire AI Agents to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.fidelic.ai/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is FidelicAI: Hire AI Agents MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, FidelicAI: Hire AI Agents scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the FidelicAI: Hire AI Agents MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: FidelicAI: Hire AI Agents provides these MCP tools: browse_roster, compare_work_options, get_agent, get_fidelicai_overview, get_help_and_community, read_publication, search_publications, and start_hire.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to FidelicAI: Hire AI Agents?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to FidelicAI: Hire AI Agents in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does FidelicAI: Hire AI Agents MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: FidelicAI: Hire AI Agents does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Who develops FidelicAI: Hire AI Agents?

acceptedAnswer.text: FidelicAI: Hire AI Agents is developed by FidelicAI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
